# Constitution — Yokai Tennis
<!-- Auto-generated by /ss:init on 2026-07-07. Source: src/SPEC.md resolved decisions & non-goals. -->

## Principles

### P1. No on-screen shot buttons

Shot input is exclusively dual virtual joystick: left = movement, right = aim/shot trigger.
Shot type (lob/smash/slice/topspin) is derived from joystick gesture, not discrete buttons.

**Why:** SPEC.md Resolved Decision #4 and Wireframes ("In-Game Court (HUD)") explicitly rule
out shot buttons in favor of gesture-driven joystick input.

### P2. No mandatory login to play

The game must be fully playable (Quick Match, Circuit) without any account or login. Patreon
OAuth surfaces only when a player taps a Patreon-locked character.

**Why:** SPEC.md Resolved Decision #7 — Room-only persistence for MVP; auth is unlock
verification only, never a play gate.

### P3. No silent failure on unlock/payment flows

Patreon verification and IAP purchase flows must always end in an explicit success or
explicit failure message shown to the user — never a silent no-op.

**Why:** SPEC.md Flow 2 (step 5b: "ineligible tier → message shown explaining required
tier") and Flow 4 (IAP) — monetization-adjacent flows are called out as needing to be
unambiguous to the player.

### P4. Non-goals stay out of scope

Do not implement: online/async PvP, character stat upgrades/progression meta, cross-play
cloud save with a PC version, or leaderboards — unless SPEC.md is updated to move one of
these out of Non-Goals first.

**Why:** SPEC.md "Non-Goals" section is an explicit scope fence to prevent feature creep
during MVP build-out.

### P5. Landscape-only orientation

All UI and gameplay screens are designed and implemented landscape-only, locked.

**Why:** SPEC.md Tech Stack table and Wireframes assume landscape throughout; portrait
support is not designed for and would require separate wireframes.
